name: pusslet-functions
description: Cloud Functions and Firestore security rules tests for Pusslet

scripts.test: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth --project demo-pusslet "vitest run"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-pusslet
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-pusslet "vitest run test/rules.test.ts"
